data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has prior year reserves releases of $8.8m in 2020 (2019: strengthen of $6.8m), primarily driven by claims releases on the older years of account in the specialty lines division.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3623 reported prior year reserve releases of $8.8 million in 2020, representing a 3.1% release against opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by claims releases on older years of account within the specialty lines division. The report also noted adverse COVID-19 related claims experience impacting the overall claims ratio.
raw_causal_phrases: claims releases on the older years of account in the specialty lines division
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is from narrative text and assumed to be net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated or calculable from available tables. The claims development table on page 14 provides percentages for development periods, not absolute monetary values, so it could not be used for the claims triangle.
